name: atlas-virtual-office
description: Atlas virtual office for a focused 20-person team

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @atlas/api && npm run build --workspace @atlas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @atlas/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @atlas/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @atlas/api && npm run test --workspace @atlas/web
scripts.logs: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local.yaml logs -f web api
